purpose: Define source, unit, comparator, history, normalization, provenance, and scoring authority before a market feature can reach the regime rulebook.

quality.freshness_factor: 1 when fresh, 0 when stale, linear between thresholds
quality.provenance_rule: observed or transparent derived features may score; proxy, context-only, unavailable, or planned features may not score

hl_mark_price_usd.decision_role: Base measurement used to derive returns; an absolute price is not a direction score.
caveats: Current mark price is retained as a base measurement and is the source series for the one-hour return comparator; the price itself remains ineligible to score.

hl_return_1h_pct.comparator: mark price at or immediately before t minus 1 hour, rejected when the anchor lags the one-hour target by more than the configured tolerance
hl_return_1h_pct.decision_role: Directional price movement over the intraday decision horizon.
hl_return_1h_pct.missing_data: Feature unavailable; price/volatility block loses coverage.
caveats: Requires durable, timestamp-aligned mark-price history; the derivation emits no value when no anchor exists at or before t minus one hour.
A data gap wider than the anchor tolerance suppresses the feature rather than widening the comparator window.

hl_spread_bps.source: Hyperliquid l2Book best bid and best ask
hl_spread_bps.comparator: spread divided by the same-book midpoint
hl_spread_bps.missing_data: Liquidity block loses spread contribution and coverage.
caveats: Polling snapshots can miss brief spread spikes.

hl_depth_25bp_usd.source: Hyperliquid l2Book levels within 25 bps of midpoint
hl_depth_25bp_usd.comparator: rolling history for the same symbol and feature definition
hl_depth_25bp_usd.decision_role: More nearby two-sided depth improves liquidity suitability.
hl_depth_25bp_usd.missing_data: Liquidity block loses depth contribution and coverage.
caveats: Displayed orders may be cancelled and do not guarantee executable depth.

hl_buy_impact_5k_bps.source: Book walk over Hyperliquid l2Book asks for 5000 USD
hl_buy_impact_5k_bps.comparator: rolling history for the same symbol, side, and notional
hl_buy_impact_5k_bps.decision_role: Higher estimated buy impact reduces liquidity suitability.
hl_buy_impact_5k_bps.missing_data: Liquidity block loses impact contribution and coverage.
caveats: Current implementation models buy-side impact only and is an estimate, not a fill promise.

hl_funding_hourly_rate.comparator: rolling hourly funding history for the same contract
hl_funding_hourly_rate.decision_role: Crowding evidence whose sign must be interpreted with side, OI, and price—not as standalone direction.
hl_funding_hourly_rate.missing_data: Positioning block loses funding evidence and coverage.
caveats: Positive funding means longs pay shorts; it does not automatically mean price will fall.

hl_funding_apr_24h.source: Mean hourly Hyperliquid funding over 24 hours
hl_funding_apr_24h.decision_role: Human-readable simple annualization: mean hourly rate times 24 times 365.
caveats: Simple annualization is a rate comparison, not a realized or compounded return forecast.

hl_open_interest_4h_pct.source: Hyperliquid open interest converted to USD with mark price
hl_open_interest_4h_pct.comparator: earliest valid OI observation inside the prior 4-hour window
hl_open_interest_4h_pct.decision_role: Leverage build or unwind; direction requires price/funding context.
hl_open_interest_4h_pct.missing_data: Positioning block loses OI evidence and coverage.
caveats: USD OI changes with both contract quantity and mark price.

hl_volume_24h_usd.comparator: rolling history of the same rolling-24h field
hl_volume_24h_usd.decision_role: Participation intensity; high volume is not direction by itself.
hl_volume_24h_usd.missing_data: Price/volatility block loses activity evidence and coverage.
caveats: Current 5m, 1h, and 4h volume fields are estimates from 24h volume and are not admitted features.

hl_orderbook_imbalance_1pct.source: Hyperliquid l2Book bid and ask depth within 1 percent
hl_orderbook_imbalance_1pct.comparator: rolling history for the same symbol and depth band
hl_orderbook_imbalance_1pct.decision_role: Short-lived bid/ask depth asymmetry used only as supporting evidence.
hl_orderbook_imbalance_1pct.missing_data: Liquidity block loses imbalance contribution and coverage.
caveats: Order-book imbalance can be cancelled or spoofed and must not become a standalone signal.

hl_oracle_premium_bps.source: Hyperliquid markPx and oraclePx or the venue premium field
hl_oracle_premium_bps.comparator: Hyperliquid validator oracle price aligned to the mark observation
hl_oracle_premium_bps.decision_role: Perpetual-versus-oracle premium; not Coinbase premium and not independent spot demand.
hl_oracle_premium_bps.missing_data: Positioning block loses premium evidence and coverage.
caveats: Derived from aligned Hyperliquid markPx and oraclePx; it is not Coinbase premium and does not independently prove spot demand.

hl_liquidation_total_proxy_usd.decision_role: Legacy diagnostic only; cannot establish liquidation direction or score a playbook.
caveats: The current 50/50 long-short split is not observed market truth.

hl_direct_liquidation_flow.decision_role: Reserved for observed venue-supported liquidation events.
hl_direct_liquidation_flow.missing_data: Show unavailable; never substitute the OI proxy as observed direction.
caveats: No current public adapter supplies direct side-labelled liquidations.

hl_direct_cvd.source: Hyperliquid trades websocket, signed taker notional
hl_direct_cvd.comparator: signed taker notional over a rolling five-minute window
hl_direct_cvd.decision_role: Observed taker buy/sell flow; sustained aggressive buying is directional evidence.
hl_direct_cvd.missing_data: Show unavailable; never substitute candle or volume estimates.
caveats: Do not present candle or volume estimates as direct CVD.
Side convention B=aggressive buy, A=aggressive sell was determined empirically against the live order book on 2026-09-08; the venue does not document it.
Absent rather than zero until trades are observed, since zero is a real reading meaning balanced flow.

coinbase_premium_bps.source: Coinbase Exchange BTC/ETH/SOL-USD ticker mid versus the Hyperliquid mark
coinbase_premium_bps.comparator: Coinbase book mid minus Hyperliquid mark, over the mark, rejected when the two venues were sampled more than 10s apart
coinbase_premium_bps.decision_role: Spot demand above the perpetual is read as directional support. Admitted to scoring by operator decision on 2026-09-08; Coinbase remains a price reference and never a trading venue.
caveats: Coinbase is an external reference venue, not the trading venue. Hyperliquid remains the only venue TradeSync trades on.
Robust z-score is used because a premium spikes; an ordinary z-score would let one dislocation distort the baseline for a whole session.
Book mid is used rather than the last trade, so a single print cannot read as premium.
A premium is not computed when the two venues were sampled more than 10s apart; sampling lag would otherwise present as market structure.
CoinGecko aggregate spot context is not an equivalent replacement.

bitcoin_etf_net_flow_usd.source: No admitted free primary flow source
bitcoin_etf_net_flow_usd.comparator: Prior daily flows after publication timestamp
bitcoin_etf_net_flow_usd.decision_role: Slow context; cannot trigger a trade or create intraday direction alone.
caveats: Publication timing and later revisions must be stored to prevent look-ahead bias.

verified_external_event_risk.source: Future verified event registry with provenance and effective timestamps
verified_external_event_risk.decision_role: May create a risk cap; cannot assign bullish or bearish direction.
caveats: Event severity and market impact are distinct variables.
